title: Jubilant British Seitan Cornish Pasty
description: A savory vegan dish featuring seitan and chocolate chips in a traditional Cornish pasty, served on a cedar plank. This dish is perfect for a post-workout meal in the Yorkshire style.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, seitan, smoked tofu, chocolate chips, and melted vegan butter.
Add the chopped onion, diced potato, and diced swede to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a plate or a pastry cutter to cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the seitan and vegetable mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Fold the other half of the dough circle over the filling to form a pasty, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the pasties on a cedar plank lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pasties in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
